title: Pinching rigidity theorems for normal scalar curvature
summary: Let $M^n$ be an $n$-dimensional closed minimal submanifold immersed in the unit sphere $\mathbb{S}^{n+m}$. Denote by $S$ and $ρ^{\perp}$ the squared norm of the second fundamental form and the normal scalar curvature of $M^n$, respectively. Let $\{A^α\}_{α=n+1}^{n+m}$ be the shape operators of $M^n$ with respect to a local orthonormal normal frame. Denote by $λ_{1}$ the largest eigenvalue of the positive semi-definite symmetric matrix $\mathcal{A}=(\langle A^α,A^β\rangle)_{m\times m}$.
